capabilities: Search notes using a local knowledge base (RAG)
Run agents for reading and editing notes
extras: The plugin is free and open source (MIT). Note that certain features use Node's fs and can read or write paths outside the vault, and installed skills may execute dynamic code.
problem: Users need a powerful, flexible AI assistant that can interact with their private notes, run complex tasks, and maintain context without relying on external, disconnected tools.
summary: AI Chat Assistant provides a multi-model interface for chatting, running intelligent agents, and performing knowledge base retrieval (RAG) within Obsidian.
